notes: The loader's shipped defaults now live in a small data file rather than being written into the code, so promoting a tuned set is five numbers moving between two files instead of an edit to the app.

Added the tool that does the moving: it reads the values you saved in Options, shows exactly what would change, and writes them only when told to - then reads the file back to confirm. That way the values that ship are provably the ones…
No visible change. This is the machinery behind define it, save it, and it becomes what a fresh install starts with.
